name: Percy Klanzeal
original_name: パーシィ・クランジール
source:
[u][b]The Two-Faced Dhampir Oppai Spy![/b][/u]
Race: Dhampir
Code Name: Night Girl
Second Year at Espiona Girls' Academy
Assigned Class: Snake Unit
Club: Spy Acrobat Club

Percy is a second-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and a dhampir: a half-vampire, half-human. She is one of the top students in the Snake Unit, a class specializing in infiltration and stealth.

She has the trait of being more human-like during the day and more strongly influenced by her vampire blood at night. Her personality also makes a change during this cycle. During the day she is lethargic and unmotivated, while at night she becomes high-energy and excitable. Her physical abilities rank among the best across all three classes, and she particularly excels at parkour. She can infiltrate almost any location with ease, though her abilities drop significantly during the daytime.

During the day, her lazy and sluggish nature stands out, and she is often compared to “overcooked noodles.” However, she plays the role of the straight man, keeping both her senior Safia and her junior Shani in check, making her an important part of the group. At night, she becomes energetic and lively. With no one left to rein things in, the Snake Unit at night is said to be completely uncontrollable.

Percy herself considers her split personality between day and night to be “a pain,” but she grows fond of the protagonist, who finds both sides of her interesting and accepts them. During the day, they spend time indoors reading manga or playing games together. At night, they go out into the city and compete in parkour, enjoying themselves that way.

Her codename is “Night Girl,” named for how she truly shines after dark. Her ability as a spy focuses on infiltration using her exceptional physical capabilities. She can traverse extreme heights and tight spaces alone with ease. However, this only applies at night. During the day, she is apparently prone to tripping on stairs.

Her boobs are P-cups, with a “always lifted, rocket-like shape even during the day” style. Their sensitivity differs between day and night as well, with them being more sensitive at night and more prone to producing milk. Her specialty in honey traps is a versatile style, taking a more passive role during the day and an aggressive approach at night.

Her hobbies are watching manga and anime during the day, and parkour and general physical activity at night.

Her mother, Elisia, is the passionate physical education teacher at the academy who is also pure-blood vampire that overcame her weakness to sunlight through sheer effort and determination. While their personalities differ quite a bit during the day, they get along well at night and can often be seen leaping through the city together.
